scope: public header, navigation and route shell composition
rules: feature-owned and shared components follow the same responsibility rules; scope changes reuse reach, not engineering quality
line count is not a decomposition criterion; responsibilities, change reasons and coupling are the criteria
route visibility and active-navigation policy must not be embedded in presentational header composition
scroll observation behavior must remain isolated from brand, navigation and CTA rendering
public visual personality may remain unique while implementation responsibilities stay explicit and bounded
shared public layout must not depend on theory-of-change feature implementation details
Canvas Golden State remains outside SO-015 runtime ownership
